# 3d-slab-stack

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Stacked extruded slabs, staircase treads, folded ribbon tiers. Backdrop: Light studio. Items: 3 to 7. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Family item colours, one per slab, cycled top to bottom
- Monochrome variant (ref-03): one hue stepped from light to dark across tiers, for ranked or funnel content
- Light studio backdrop; slab side faces one shade darker than the top face

## Visual elements

- Slabs extruded 8 to 12 percent of their width, seen from a slight top-left angle
- Lettered or numbered disc set into each slab's front face
- Staircase variant: treads step up and to the side, one icon per tread, big numeral outside the tread
- Ribbon variant: angled folded bands that overlap, with a hexagon tab carrying the letter
- Text sits beside the stack in the whitespace, linked by short leader lines or simple proximity
- Optional stat column: oversized number in item colour with a two-line caption

## Typography

- Family typography; letters and numerals on slabs are the largest text on the page
- Tier names bold caps beside each slab, description light charcoal below the name

## Composition rules

- Stack occupies the left 45 to 55 percent of a landscape canvas, text column on the right
- Portrait: stack centred, text alternating left and right
- Three to seven tiers; more than seven, switch to 3d-paper-tile
- Staircase reads bottom-left to top-right (01 at the bottom)

## Layout

### Structure

- Vertical stack of thick extruded slabs, one slab per item
- Each slab wider or narrower than its neighbour so the stack reads as tiers
- Lettered or numbered disc set into the front face of every slab
- Text column beside the stack, one block per slab
- Optional base slab or stat column anchoring the stack

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Stacked slabs** | Tiers, layers, ranked lists | One colour per slab |
| **Staircase** | Step sequences with progression | Treads rise bottom-left to top-right, numeral on each tread |
| **Folded ribbon** | Funnels, narrowing stages | Angled bands overlap, hexagon tab carries the letter |

### Visual Elements

- Slabs extruded 8 to 12 percent of their width, seen from a slight top-left angle
- Side faces one shade darker than top faces, single light source
- Large numeral or letter on each slab as the wayfinding cue
- Short leader lines or plain proximity linking slab to text
- Monochrome option: one hue stepped light to dark across tiers

### Text Placement

- Title at top, left-aligned
- Tier name bold beside each slab, description below the name
- Stack occupies the left 45 to 55 percent of a landscape canvas, text on the right
- Portrait: stack centred, text alternating left and right
- Closing line or stat on the base slab top face

## Prompt fragment

```
Render as a polished corporate 3D infographic built from stacked extruded slabs: each item is a thick glossy block with visible side faces one shade darker than its top, stacked in reading order with a lettered or numbered disc set into its face. Alternatives for step content: a zig-zag 3D staircase with one coloured tread per step, or overlapping folded ribbon tiers with hexagon tabs. Light off-white to grey studio backdrop, soft offset drop shadows, subtle top-left highlights. One saturated colour per item cycling through teal, orange, magenta, royal blue, lime green, purple. Labels sit in the whitespace beside the stack in geometric sans-serif: bold all-caps names, light charcoal descriptions, oversized stat numerals in the item colour. No hand-drawn lines, no paper texture, no cartoon characters, no photographic realism, no watermarks, no placeholder text. Clean premium business-template 3D.
```

## Best for

- Tiered architectures and technology stacks
- Priority levels and ranked lists
- Funnel stages
- Step sequences with a strong sense of climb
